question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a brown ball, Bob has a black ball, and Claire has a red ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Alice swap balls. Then, Claire and Bob swap balls. Finally, Alice and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) brown ball
(B) black ball
(C) red ball
solution:
Ball colors in player order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (brown, black, red)
1. Claire and Alice swap: (red, black, brown)
2. Claire and Bob swap: (red, brown, black)
3. Alice and Claire swap: (black, brown, red)
Bob has the brown ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
